## 🏗️ Arquitectura de Componentes

### Regla de Oro: Patrón Wrapper

**NUNCA** importar componentes de heroui-native directamente en screens, organisms o molecules. **SIEMPRE** crear atoms wrapper.

```typescript
// ❌ INCORRECTO
import { Button, TextField } from 'heroui-native';

export default function RegisterScreen() {
  return <Button>Submit</Button>;
}

// ✅ CORRECTO
import { ButtonAtom } from '@/ui/components/atoms/button.atom';

export default function RegisterScreen() {
  return <ButtonAtom title="common.submit" />;
}
```

**Razones:**
1. Consistencia de estilos en toda la app
2. i18n centralizado
3. Props personalizadas (e.g., `i18nKey` en lugar de `children`)
4. Facilita cambios globales de diseño

---

## 🎨 Sistema de Temas

### useThemeColor Hook

heroui-native proporciona `useThemeColor` para colores dinámicos basados en el tema activo (claro/oscuro).

```typescript
import { useThemeColor } from 'heroui-native';

export function MyAtom() {
  const backgroundColor = useThemeColor('background');
  const foregroundColor = useThemeColor('foreground');
  const accentColor = useThemeColor('accent');
  const mutedColor = useThemeColor('muted');

  return (
    <View style={{ backgroundColor }}>
      <Text style={{ color: foregroundColor }}>Texto</Text>
    </View>
  );
}
```

### Colores Disponibles

| Key          | Uso                                    | Light Mode     | Dark Mode      |
|--------------|----------------------------------------|----------------|----------------|
| `background` | Fondo principal de la app              | `#FFFFFF`      | `#000000`      |
| `foreground` | Texto principal                        | `#000000`      | `#FFFFFF`      |
| `accent`     | Color de acento/primario               | Brand color    | Brand color    |
| `muted`      | Texto secundario/deshabilitado         | `#6B7280`      | `#9CA3AF`      |
| `primary`    | Estado semántico: primario             | `#3B82F6`      | `#60A5FA`      |
| `success`    | Estado semántico: éxito                | `#10B981`      | `#34D399`      |
| `warning`    | Estado semántico: advertencia          | `#F59E0B`      | `#FBBF24`      |
| `danger`     | Estado semántico: error/peligro        | `#EF4444`      | `#F87171`      |

### Usar Colores del Tema

**✅ CORRECTO** (dinámico):
```typescript
const textColor = useThemeColor('foreground');
<Text style={{ color: textColor }}>Hello</Text>
```

**❌ INCORRECTO** (hardcoded):
```typescript
<Text style={{ color: '#000000' }}>Hello</Text>
```

**Excepción:** Colores de diseño específicos que NO deben cambiar con el tema (e.g., colores de estado en toasts).

## 📦 Componentes Base de heroui-native

### Compound Components Pattern

heroui-native usa el patrón de **compound components** para composición flexible:

```typescript
import { Button, TextField, Card } from 'heroui-native';

// Button compound
<Button variant="primary" size="lg">
  <Button.Label>Submit</Button.Label>
</Button>

// TextField compound
<TextField>
  <TextField.Label>Email</TextField.Label>
  <TextField.Input placeholder="you@example.com">
    <TextField.InputStartContent>
      <Ionicons name="mail-outline" size={16} />
    </TextField.InputStartContent>
  </TextField.Input>
</TextField>

// Card compound
<Card>
  <Card.Header>
    <Card.Title>Title</Card.Title>
  </Card.Header>
  <Card.Body>
    <Card.Description>Description</Card.Description>
  </Card.Body>
  <Card.Footer>Footer content</Card.Footer>
</Card>
```

### Props Comunes

| Prop           | Tipo                                        | Descripción                          |
|----------------|---------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------|
| `variant`      | `'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'outline'`     | Variante visual                      |
| `size`         | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'`                      | Tamaño del componente                |
| `color`        | `'primary' \| 'success' \| 'warning'`...    | Color semántico                      |
| `isDisabled`   | `boolean`                                   | Deshabilitado                        |
| `isRequired`   | `boolean`                                   | Campo requerido (forms)              |
| `className`    | `string`                                    | Clases Tailwind adicionales          |

## 🧬 Crear Atoms Wrapper

### Patrón General

```typescript
// atoms/{component}.atom.tsx
import { {Component} } from 'heroui-native';
import { TypographyParagraph } from './typography.atom';
import type { Ti18nKeys } from '@/ui/i18n/locales/en-EN';

interface {Component}AtomProps extends Omit<{Component}Props, 'children'> {
  titleKey?: Ti18nKeys;  // i18n key para texto
}

export const {Component}Atom = ({ titleKey, ...props }: {Component}AtomProps) => {
  return (
    <{Component} className="rounded-lg" {...props}>
      {titleKey && <TypographyParagraph i18nKey={titleKey} />}
    </{Component}>
  );
};
```

### Ejemplo: ButtonAtom

```typescript
// atoms/button.atom.tsx
import { Button, type ButtonProps } from 'heroui-native';
import { TypographyParagraph } from './typography.atom';
import type { Ti18nKeys } from '@/ui/i18n/locales/en-EN';

interface ButtonAtomProps extends Omit<ButtonProps, 'children'> {
  title: Ti18nKeys;
}

export const ButtonAtom = ({ title, ...props }: ButtonAtomProps) => {
  return (
    <Button className="rounded-lg" {...props}>
      <TypographyParagraph className="text-white" i18nKey={title} />
    </Button>
  );
};
```

**Uso:**
```typescript
<ButtonAtom
  title="auth.sign-in"
  variant="primary"
  size="lg"
  onPress={handleSubmit}
/>
```

### Ejemplo: TextFieldAtom

```typescript
// atoms/text-field.atom.tsx
import { TextField, type TextFieldProps } from 'heroui-native';
import { TypographySmall } from './typography.atom';
import { IconAtom } from './icon.atom';
import type { Ti18nKeys } from '@/ui/i18n/locales/en-EN';
import type { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';

interface TextFieldAtomProps extends Omit<TextFieldProps, 'children'> {
  labelKey: Ti18nKeys;
  iconName?: keyof typeof Ionicons.glyphMap;
}

export const TextFieldAtom = ({
  labelKey,
  iconName,
  ...props
}: TextFieldAtomProps) => {
  return (
    <TextField {...props}>
      <TextField.Label>
        <TypographySmall i18nKey={labelKey} />
      </TextField.Label>
      <TextField.Input>
        {iconName && (
          <TextField.InputStartContent>
            <IconAtom name={iconName} />
          </TextField.InputStartContent>
        )}
      </TextField.Input>
    </TextField>
  );
};
```

**Uso:**
```typescript
<TextFieldAtom
  labelKey="auth.email"
  iconName="mail-outline"
  placeholder="you@example.com"
  keyboardType="email-address"
/>
```

## 📝 Typography System

Ver archivo completo: `5.ui-components/1.atomic-design.instructions.md`

### Variantes Disponibles

```typescript
import {
  TypographyTitle,      // 3xl, bold - Títulos principales
  TypographySubtitle,   // 2xl, bold - Subtítulos
  TypographyHeading,    // xl, semibold - Encabezados
  TypographyParagraph,  // base, normal - Texto cuerpo
  TypographySmall,      // sm, normal - Texto pequeño
} from '@/ui/components/atoms/typography.atom';
```

### Props Comunes

```typescript
interface TypographyProps {
  i18nKey: Ti18nKeys;              // Clave de traducción
  variant?: 'default' | 'primary' | 'light';  // Color
  size?: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'base' | 'lg' | 'xl' | '2xl' | '3xl' | '4xl';
  weight?: 'normal' | 'medium' | 'semibold' | 'bold';
  className?: string;
  style?: TextStyle;
}
```

### Uso con useThemeColor

Typography atoms integran `useThemeColor` automáticamente:

```typescript
const TypographyParagraph = ({ variant = 'default', ... }) => {
  const foregroundColor = useThemeColor('foreground');
  const accentColor = useThemeColor('accent');
  const mutedColor = useThemeColor('muted');

  const colorMap = {
    default: foregroundColor,
    primary: accentColor,
    light: mutedColor,
  };

  return (
    <Text style={[{ color: colorMap[variant] }, style]} {...props}>
      <TextTranslation i18nKey={i18nKey} />
    </Text>
  );
};
```

## 🎯 Layout Components

### Estructura de Pantalla Estándar

```typescript
import { View, ScrollView } from 'react-native';
import { TypographyTitle, TypographyParagraph } from '@/ui/components/atoms/typography.atom';
import { useThemeColor } from 'heroui-native';

export default function MyScreen() {
  const backgroundColor = useThemeColor('background');

  return (
    <View style={{ backgroundColor, flex: 1 }} className="p-6">
      <ScrollView>
        {/* Header */}
        <View className="mb-6">
          <TypographyTitle i18nKey="screen.title" />
          <TypographyParagraph
            variant="light"
            i18nKey="screen.description"
          />
        </View>

        {/* Content */}
        <View className="space-y-4">
          {/* ... content ... */}
        </View>
      </ScrollView>
    </View>
  );
}
```

### SafeAreaView Pattern

```typescript
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

export default function MyScreen() {
  const backgroundColor = useThemeColor('background');

  return (
    <SafeAreaView
      style={{ backgroundColor, flex: 1 }}
      edges={['top', 'bottom']}
    >
      {/* content */}
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}
```

## 🎨 Integración con NativeWind

### Uso de className

```typescript
<View className="flex-1 p-4 bg-background">
  <View className="rounded-xl border border-muted p-3">
    <TypographyParagraph i18nKey="content.text" />
  </View>
</View>
```

### Combinar con Style

```typescript
const dynamicColor = useThemeColor('accent');

<View
  style={{ backgroundColor: dynamicColor }}
  className="rounded-2xl p-4"
>
  {/* content */}
</View>
```

**Regla:** Usa `style` para valores dinámicos (theme colors, animations), `className` para valores estáticos.

## ♿ Accesibilidad

### Props de Accesibilidad Obligatorias

```typescript
<Pressable
  accessibilityRole="button"
  accessibilityLabel={t('action.submit')}
  accessibilityHint={t('action.submit.hint')}
  onPress={handleSubmit}
>
  <TypographyParagraph i18nKey="action.submit" />
</Pressable>
```

### Estados de Accesibilidad

```typescript
<Pressable
  accessibilityRole="checkbox"
  accessibilityState={{
    checked: isChecked,
    disabled: isDisabled,
  }}
  onPress={toggleCheck}
>
  {/* content */}
</Pressable>
```

### Tamaños Mínimos de Toque

- **iOS:** 44x44pt
- **Android:** 48x48dp

```typescript
<Pressable className="min-w-[44px] min-h-[44px]">
  {/* content */}
</Pressable>
```

---

## 🚫 Anti-Patrones a Evitar

| Anti-Patrón | Problema | Solución |
|-------------|----------|----------|
| Importar heroui-native en screens | Rompe consistencia | Usar atoms wrapper |
| Hardcodear colores | No respeta tema | Usar `useThemeColor` |
| Hardcodear strings | Sin i18n | Usar `i18nKey` con `Ti18nKeys` |
| `style={{ color: '#000' }}` | No adapta a dark mode | `useThemeColor('foreground')` |
| Omitir `accessibilityRole` | Mala a11y | Siempre incluir en interactivos |
| Touch targets < 44px | Difícil de tocar | `min-w-[44px] min-h-[44px]` |

## 📚 Componentes Disponibles en heroui-native

### Componentes Base
- `Button` - Botones con variantes
- `TextField` - Inputs de texto
- `Card` - Tarjetas contenedoras
- `Spinner` - Indicadores de carga
- `Switch` - Toggle switches
- `Checkbox` - Checkboxes
- `Radio` - Radio buttons
- `Select` - Selectores dropdown
- `Modal` - Modales nativos

### Compound Components
Todos los componentes arriba soportan el patrón compound:
- `{Component}.Label`
- `{Component}.Description`
- `{Component}.Error`

### Layout Components
- `Stack` - Layout vertical/horizontal
- `Divider` - Separadores
- `Spacer` - Espaciado flexible
